turns.agent:
The connected Magic Hour tools don’t allow face swaps involving children, including childhood photos of someone who is now an adult, so I can’t make this swap.

I can instead create a fictional young astronaut portrait, keeping the poster vertical and aiming to preserve the rest of its design.
